  Computer Vision [IT-4031]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Examine 2D Convolution Filter in detail. Solve the given input image (f) with its kernel  
  (h) using convolution filtering method and display the output image (g) for the pixel  
  values - (0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 4).  
  A)  
  
  (5)  
  
  
  B)      Justify why filters are used on an image. Also, discuss various filters used for noise  
  reduction on an image.                                                                      (3)  
  
  C)      Define Computer Vision? Why is vision so difficult? Discuss various color models that  
  are involved in computer vision.                                                            (2)  
  
  2)           With respect to Scale Invariant Feature Transform SIFT), examine the following steps to  
  extract and interpret the key points in an image.  
  (i) Scale space peak selection.  
  A)      (ii) Key point localization.                                                            (5)  
  (iii) Orientation assignment.  
  (iv) Key point descriptor.  
  
  B)      Identify various image feature detection methods and discuss in detail.                     (3)  
  C)      How is the detection of humans achieved through the utilization of Histogram of  
  Oriented Gradient (HOG) features?                                                           (2)  
  
  3)           Examine the mathematics involved in computing the 3D coordinates of a point  
  illuminated by a light stripe plane having equation aX + bY + cZ + d = 0 using a known  
  (5)  
  camera calibration matrix C.  
  A)  
  B)      What is the reason behind tilting of Epipolar lines? How do you correct this to get a       (5)  
  horizontal line to simplify the search for corresponding points between two images?
